workflow_instructions: For an account brief, include the company, account owner, renewal date, annual value, and open support tickets with priorities. When a support mapping and support tool are available, retrieve those tickets before giving the final brief; do not merely offer to check them later. Reuse account fields already returned by search. If support access or a mapping is unavailable, explicitly state that ticket information could not be checked. Ask for clarification when multiple accounts match.

workflow_prompts.label: Meeting preparation
workflow_prompts.message: Prepare a meeting brief for Acme using account details and open support tickets. Explain what other information is unavailable.
